description: Is a keyword worth what it costs, and what would fix it. Over a trailing window (range 7d, 30d or 90d; default 30d): a status (healthy; noisy = 20 or more scored matches and under 30% relevant; quiet = 7 days or older with nothing relevant; capped; paused; new = under 7 days old) with reasons in plain words, matches, relevant, noise share by platform and week, what it cost, the words and authors over-represented in its noise, and suggestions. Each suggestion has a `patch`: pass it to update_keyword with the keyword id to apply it (lists hold the whole new list), and an `effect` measured by running the matcher's rules over the window's posts (noise and relevant matches it would have removed, cents saved). ai=true adds a context rewritten by a language model (cached a day; 20 model calls an hour per workspace). Read only, never billed, cached 5 minutes.

ai.description: true: also ask a language model for a rewritten context. Default false.
